verdict.rationale: Instinct documents a deletion control for all data indexed from external sources, and a community report corroborates that the vendor added this settings tool after a user's Gmail records initially would not delete. Hands-on reports also show that disconnecting a source keeps already-indexed data, stored in plain text, until the user runs the separate delete tool. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or auto-expiry, documented deletion of non-indexed data (conversations, Vault, voice), automatic purge on disconnect, and independent verification that deletion is complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can delete all data indexed from external sources by visiting app.instinct.com/workspace.
He later said the team fixed it by adding a settings tool for deleting external data.
